label: Raw hex outside tokens
means: Colors typed straight into the code instead of taken from the brand palette; fewer is better.
goal_source: Git Crafter default goal: every color comes from the design tokens (params.tokens), the one source of the palette. The Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10 shares tokens across disciplines, tools and technologies (designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format, 2025-10-28, read 2026-11-10); zero is a Git Crafter default
source: state: regex scan of params.src_dirs (params.scan_extensions), comments stripped; params.raw_scan_exempt says which files or lines are left out, and why

label: Raw px outside tokens
means: Fixed sizes typed straight into the code instead of taken from the shared scale; fewer is better.
goal_source: Git Crafter default goal: every size comes from the token scale. The Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10 shares tokens across disciplines, tools and technologies (designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format, 2025-10-28, read 2026-11-10); zero is a Git Crafter default; the near band is wide, since a border or an icon size often has no token
source: state: regex scan of params.src_dirs (params.scan_extensions), comments stripped; params.raw_scan_exempt says which files or lines are left out

label: Off-scale font sizes
means: Different text sizes on the pages that are not in the brand's size scale; fewer is better.
goal_source: Git Crafter default goal: every text size is a step of the type scale in params.tokens. The Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10 shares tokens across disciplines, tools and technologies (designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format, 2025-10-28, read 2026-11-10); zero is a Git Crafter default
source: state: Playwright (Chrome) computed font-size of visible text on params.key_pages at params.widths, against the type scale in params.tokens (within 0.5 px)

label: Off-token text colors
means: Different text colors on the pages that are not in the brand palette; fewer is better.
goal_source: Git Crafter default goal: every text color is a color token in params.tokens. The Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10 shares tokens across disciplines, tools and technologies (designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format, 2025-10-28, read 2026-11-10); zero is a Git Crafter default
source: state: Playwright (Chrome) computed color of visible text on params.key_pages at params.widths, against the colors in params.tokens

label: Contrast failures (axe)
means: Page elements whose text is hard to read against its background; fewer is better.
goal_source: goal: WCAG 2.2 AA, Success Criterion 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), as axe-core's color-contrast rule tests it (w3.org/TR/WCAG22); the near band is a Git Crafter default
source: state: axe-core color-contrast (the version installed in the repo, else beside the collectors) injected by Playwright (Chrome), params.key_pages at params.widths

label: LCP, mobile, slowest page
means: How long the main content takes to appear on a phone, for the slowest page, in seconds; lower is better.
goal_source: goal: a good Largest Contentful Paint is 2.5 s or less and a poor one over 4 s, per Core Web Vitals (web.dev/articles/vitals and web.dev/articles/lcp, read 2026-11-03)
source: latest: PageSpeed Insights API v5, strategy=mobile, lab LCP, params.key_pages; a page PSI cannot answer, and every page of a built static site, is measured by our own Playwright lab run under Lighthouse's mobile settings and marked (lab)

label: CLS, mobile, worst page
means: How much the worst page jumps around while loading on a phone; lower is better.
goal_source: goal: a good Cumulative Layout Shift is 0.1 or less and a poor one over 0.25, per Core Web Vitals (web.dev/articles/vitals and web.dev/articles/cls, read 2026-11-03)
source: latest: PageSpeed Insights API v5, strategy=mobile, lab CLS, params.key_pages; a page PSI cannot answer, and every page of a built static site, is measured by our own Playwright lab run under Lighthouse's mobile settings and marked (lab)

label: Total KiB, heaviest page
means: How much data the heaviest page downloads in all; less loads faster, so lower is better.
goal_source: goal: Lighthouse's total-byte-weight guidance, aim below 1,600 KiB; Lighthouse flags pages over 5,000 KiB (developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/total-byte-weight, read 2026-11-02)
source: state: Playwright (Chrome) network log, all responses at load, params.key_pages at params.widths
